task_description: Design and prototype the Autonomous Project Intelligence Agent (APIA): a portable GitHub Copilot skill package that learns any project and drives changes semi-autonomously via a gated ingest -> clarify -> modify -> test -> apply loop, running entirely on the user's Copilot session (no external LLM). Deliver the architecture/design document (full vision in phases, Phase 1 concrete) and a minimal working Phase-1 skill package for VS Code proving the end-to-end loop on one sample repo, with Python-first stack adapters and stubs for C++/C#/Groovy.
